name: ogun
description: Ogun workflow IR in VS Code: schema checking for *.workflow.json, diagnostics, hover, completion and go-to-definition from the Ogun language server or validator, workflow hashes.

ogun.path.description: Path to the ogun command-line tool.

ogun.validateOnSave.description: In CLI mode, run the Ogun validator when a *.workflow.json file is saved.

enumDescriptions: Use ogun-lsp (or `ogun lsp`) when it is found; otherwise run `ogun validate --json`.
Use the language server and log why when it cannot start.
Never start the language server; run `ogun validate --json` on open and save.
ogun.languageServer.mode.description: Whether to use the Ogun language server.

ogun.languageServer.path.description: Command that starts the Ogun language server. Empty: ogun-lsp on PATH, then `ogun lsp`.
